data.name: World of Revolution
data.detailed_description:
World of Revolution is a historical grand strategy game set in 1763, at the dawn of a turbulent new age. Lead your nation through revolution, industry, empire, and war as you modernize your economy, expand your influence, and reshape the world through diplomacy or conquest.

Built for seamless multiplayer, World of Revolution is designed for large-scale campaigns where many players compete, cooperate, and struggle for dominance on the global stage.

The year is 1763. As the dust settles after the Seven Years’ War, the old world order begins to fracture. Empires stand victorious but exhausted, colonies grow restless, and the foundations of absolute rule start to crack.

From the coming battlefields of the American Revolution to the overthrow of the Ancien Régime in France, your choices will shape not only the future of your nation, but the balance of power for generations to come. Will the old order endure, or will the world truly become a World of Revolution?

Rule is never absolute. Beneath the map lies a nation of estates, cities, provinces, factions, industries, armies, and institutions, each pulling the state toward its own future.

Guide your nation through law, economy, diplomacy, research, construction, and reform. Manage the treasury, develop key regions, empower loyal interests, and contain those who would drag the realm into crisis. Every reform, tax burden, alliance, factory, expedition, and war shifts the balance of power within the state.

Provinces are not merely land to be painted. They are centers of population, production, wealth, unrest, opportunity, and strategic value. A neglected borderland, a growing industrial city, a loyal heartland, or a rebellious capital can each shape the fate of an empire.

As the old order strains under revolution and modernization, every country must choose what kind of state it will become. Preserve privilege, centralize authority, embrace reform, or gamble on upheaval. The world will change with or without you.

No nation rises alone. In World of Revolution, every treaty, betrayal, coalition, and conquest unfolds alongside other players in a living struggle for global power. Designed from the ground up for seamless multiplayer, campaigns are built to keep the world moving as rulers enter the stage, forge alliances, wage wars, and shape history together.

From secret diplomacy and fragile peace conferences to continent-spanning wars between rival empires, multiplayer turns every campaign into a contest of ambition, trust, and survival. Will you stand with your allies through revolution and ruin, or seize the moment to carve your own empire from the ashes?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 or OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Vulkan is used by default; Compatibility renderer available for older GPUs.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: CoreAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Apple Silicon recommended.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Vulkan-compatible GPU or OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU using Compatibility renderer
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio or PipeWire compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit processor and operating system required. Vulkan is used by default; Compatibility renderer available for older GPUs.
